title: UserQueryReceived
description: Emitted by userInterface.ts when the user submits a query. Topic: user-commands.

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the conversation, shared across all events in one request.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at the time the event was produced.

eventType.description: Discriminator field identifying the event type.

userInput.description: The raw text query entered by the user.
